scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && node --import tsx apps/omni/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:coding: pnpm run dev:prepare && node --import tsx apps/omni/src/index.ts run coding
scripts.dev:financial-analysis: pnpm run dev:prepare && node --import tsx apps/omni/src/index.ts run financial-analysis
scripts.build: pnpm run build:sandbox && pnpm run clean && tsc -b --force packages/core packages/network packages/tools packages/models packages/app packages/agent-host agents/coding agents/financial-analysis examples/minimal-agent packages/ui packages/cli apps/omni && pnpm --filter @omni-agent/ui build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/network packages/tools packages/models packages/app packages/agent-host agents/coding agents/financial-analysis examples/minimal-agent packages/ui packages/cli apps/omni && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core/evals/checkpointSummary/tsconfig.json && tsc -p agents/coding/evals/clarificationRouting/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify:sandbox: pnpm run build:sandbox && OMNI_TEST_SANDBOX=1 vitest run tests/process-workspace-boundary.test.ts
